newsitem.title: USA: Baker, Fentress & Co Q3 net asset value up.
newsitem.headline: Baker, Fentress & Co Q3 net asset value up.

text.p: Baker, Fentress & Co said Thursday its net asset value at September 30 rose to $23.45 from $21.59 a share in the same period a year ago.
Total net assets at September 30 advanced to $759.8 million from $570.8 million. Average shares outdstanding were 32.4 million compared to 26.4 million a year earlier.

For the 1996 nine months, net investment income totaled $7.1 million or $0.22 per share excluding a realized gain of $49.1 million or $1.52 per share. Net investment income for the 1995 nine months totaled $7.6 million or $0.29 per share excluding a realized gain of $26.5 million or $1 per share.
